title: Come to Islam! Come to Nature!
body:
Mubarak Muharram! For the honor of Islam (...) we must come back to Islam. I am unhappy with everything
in the name of technology, I am fed up! We must bring the civilization of original Islam. Everything from
Islam, or there will be no way to save Mankind from technology and its instruments. We must come to
nature, as technology is taking Man from his real personality.
Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. I am looking, I am taking. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. I hope it will, beginning this year. Come
to Islam! Save yourselves from technology, which is making everyone (run in circles). Come to nature!
Technology is taking (a toll) on our physical being and changing our personalities, making us like machines.
Yaa Allah! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
I am nothing, but I like to be in this humble place with those who are coming to learn something of the real
way of Islam. I like that you may try to learn Holy Qur'an, that one of you teach another if he is not knowing.
Even if you give a half-hour to learn Holy Qur'an, that will be a real support for you from Heavens. Now, we
haven't anything from technology to fight them, but our spiritual power of Islam should make technology
under my feet!
O People! Don't say, "How can it be?" One orphan is making the whole world under his command, bringing

holy commands and carrying three-billion people under him up to today! We can do it by that beloved one's
power. There is no need to ask from Allah Almighty or even from His most beloved one. The weakest servant
of that chosen one, that most beloved one, most glorified one, may change this world from here up to there!
Try to be on his way, the real way of the Seal of Prophets (s).
Enough. I am not coming to speak anything, but 'they' are making this for me. I don't know, but they know. I
can't take except what they are granting.
O People! As-salaamu `alaykum.
Fatihah.
All of you are in my heart. I am taking up the holy flag of Islam!
